create_ssim_loss_instance: create an SSIMLoss instance with default window size 7 and k1 k2 parameters
compute_ssim_loss_forward: compute the SSIM loss between two image tensors X and Y using forward
use_ssim_loss_in_training: use SSIMLoss as a differentiable loss function in a PyTorch training loop
configure_ssim_window_size: configure SSIMLoss with a custom win_size to adjust the local comparison window
get_per_pixel_ssim_map: call SSIMLoss forward with reduced=False to get a per-pixel SSIM map
